This release fixes two bugs that could stop Fullstop from quitting, which also kept updates from installing.

## Fixes

- If the charging helper stops responding, Fullstop gives up after 10 seconds and shows an error instead of waiting forever. To fix the helper, open Settings, remove it, and install it again.
- Quitting Fullstop now always finishes within 5 seconds. Before, a helper that didn't respond could keep Fullstop open, and Install and Relaunch never finished.

If Install and Relaunch doesn't finish when you update from 1.0.1, quit Fullstop with Force Quit (Option-Command-Esc). The update then installs and relaunches.

## Install

Download `Fullstop.dmg` below, open it, and drag Fullstop to your Applications folder, replacing the old version. If you already have Fullstop, it updates itself. Fullstop needs a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 27 or later.

The app and disk image are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. To check your download, compare it with `Fullstop.dmg.sha256`, or verify its build provenance:

```sh
gh attestation verify Fullstop.dmg --repo firatciftci/fullstop
```
